theirReference: I hosted Cristian and his girlfriend for one night. It was a last-minute request. He and his girlfriend were great guests—they respected the house rules, were kind, and didn’t cause any problems. So, YES, I DO RECOMMEND hosting them. Or, well, if it’s just Cristian, I also recommend hosting him. Have a great trip, guys! I hope we get another chance to meet again and get to know each other better. May the Peace be with you!
